message.hollowatlas.protected.break: The land here isn't yours to dig up.
message.hollowatlas.protected.place: There's no reason to build here.
message.hollowatlas.boundary: The road beyond is not yet charted.
message.hollowatlas.no_region: This world does not contain The Hollow Atlas region. Open the bundled 'The Hollow Atlas' world instead.
item.hollowatlas.room_key.desc: A brass key to the first room up the stairs at the Rain & Lantern.
item.hollowatlas.sealed_parcel.desc: Corin's parcel for the mountain clinic. Sealed and paid for.
item.hollowatlas.valve_leather.desc: A cut of oiled hide, sized for a pump valve.
item.hollowatlas.pump_pin.desc: A sturdy pin forged by Garrick Holt.
item.hollowatlas.blue_ribbon.desc: Silk, embroidered at the ends. Chewed at one end.
item.hollowatlas.route_notes.desc: Forty years of shortcuts in very small handwriting.
item.hollowatlas.tracer_lens.desc: A brass-rimmed lens. Use it to reveal nearby traces (Echo Sight).
item.hollowatlas.technique_windstep.desc: Ilse's footwork drill. Use it to dash forward.
item.hollowatlas.herbal_remedy.desc: Hester's recipe. Smells terrible, which is a good sign.
item.hollowatlas.feverfew.desc: Small daisy-like flowers with a bitter smell.
item.hollowatlas.hearth_stew.desc: Thick and warm. Restores health over time.
item.hollowatlas.honey_bun.desc: A soft bun glazed with berries.
item.hollowatlas.trail_tonic.desc: A bitter tonic that mends small wounds at once.
item.hollowatlas.silver_locket.desc: Tarnished, with a tiny painted portrait inside. Someone's keepsake.
item.hollowatlas.old_coin.desc: A coin from before the current mint. Collectors pay well.
item.hollowatlas.courier_charm.desc: Elsie Varrow's charm. Thirty years without being late. Rarely.
item.hollowatlas.holt_hatchet.desc: Heavy and hungry. A smith's own pattern.
tooltip.hollowatlas.key_item: Key item - can't be dropped or sold
message.hollowatlas.pack_full: Your pack is full. It will be delivered when there's room.
message.hollowatlas.pending_delivered: Held items delivered to your pack.
message.hollowatlas.recovered: You come to at your last resting place. (Lost %s coins.)
message.hollowatlas.windstep_ground: You need firm footing for that.
message.hollowatlas.cannot_drop_key: You'd better hold on to that.
message.hollowatlas.key_conflict: Key conflict: '%s' and '%s' both use %s. Change one in Options > Controls.
hint.hollowatlas.ability.windstep: Windstep learned. Press Z/X (or use the technique from your hotbar) to dash forward.
hint.hollowatlas.ability.echo_sight: Echo Sight learned. Use the lens to reveal nearby traces. It spends focus (purple bar).
message.hollowatlas.boundary_return: That way isn't open yet. You turn back.
message.hollowatlas.surveying: The lands to the east are being prepared. This takes about a minute...
message.hollowatlas.surveyed: The lands to the east are ready.
item.hollowatlas.test_token.desc: A developer testing item. Exists only for testing key-item rules.
message.hollowatlas.devtest_welcome: DEVELOPER TESTING WORLD: no story content here. Press F7 (or /devtest) for the developer menu. Your story saves are separate.
